name: bun-spawn-cleanup
description: Bun.spawn drop-in that reaps spawned processes and all their descendants when the owning process exits or is killed. Kernel-guaranteed on Windows (Job Objects) and Linux (cgroup v2), best-effort Linux fallback; best-effort macOS backend (kernel lineage ids + env marker + ledger, with an auto-started kqueue daemon for SIGKILL).
author: Mrowr Purr <mrowr.purr@gmail.com>
